title: Node.js prototype pollution — recursive merge of req.body into an object
note: A POST body of {"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}} walks into Object.prototype because the recursive merge never rejects __proto__/constructor/prototype keys. Every later `obj.isAdmin` read in the process then returns true, so this is an authorization-affecting P1 rather than a data-shape nit. Object.keys() does not enumerate inherited keys, but `__proto__` IS an own enumerable key on a JSON-parsed object, so it is reached.
